title: How Gender Debiasing Affects Internal Model Representations, and Why It Matters

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring intrinsic bias using Minimum Description Length (MDL) probing for gender extractability and the Contextualized Embedding Association Test (CEAT), alongside extrinsic bias evaluation using performance gaps (True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate, Precision) and statistical fairness metrics (Independence, Separation, Sufficiency) on occupation prediction and coreference resolution tasks.
